name: eax-site
description: Static EAX Marketplace website built with Parcel for GitHub Pages.

scripts.dev: npm run write:runtime-config && parcel serve src/index.html src/equipment/index.html src/services/index.html --dist-dir public --port 1234
scripts.build: npm run check:loc && npm run write:runtime-config && parcel build src/index.html src/equipment/index.html src/services/index.html --dist-dir public --public-url / --no-source-maps
